reviews.review_msg: Textbook is like a collection of all the labels from the supermarket shampoo isle. You read through every label of every possible brand and item, then they test you " is it true brand A contains higher alcohol than brand B?" Overall extremely disappointed and required way too much time to learn new things INEFFECTIVELY. Ask around, you'll know.

Publisher quiz Qs include something like "how many hours of project management course a project manager need?" Just a very bad learning experience from this textbook as well as the mymislab online module. Its buggy,only work with IE only,unexpected error and crash ALL THE TIME.Might just use video professor's mail order crap (those are better!!!!)

Prof n material were almost ok.
